name: intuneDeviceRetirementDays
label: Enable Device Retirement in Intune
helpText: Sets the number of days of inactivity before a device is automatically retired from Intune by the default cleanup rule.
executiveText: Automatically removes long-inactive devices from management, keeping device inventory accurate and license consumption honest without manual cleanup.
docsDescription: Grades the deviceInactivityBeforeRetirementInDays value on the default (all-platforms) managed device cleanup rule. A tenant with no cleanup rule grades as drift and remediation creates the rule; otherwise the existing rule is patched in place.

days.label: Maximum days of inactivity before retirement (30-270)

min.message: Intune only accepts a retirement window between 30 and 270 days

max.message: Intune only accepts a retirement window between 30 and 270 days
